<root>:
Koala MCP Server & CLI in Rust

Usage: koala-rust [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  fact-write              Write a fact
  fact-read               Read a fact
  fact-list               List all facts
  fact-versions           Read fact versions
  fact-delete             Delete a fact
  fact-delete-prefix      Delete facts by prefix
  entity-create           Create entity
  entity-add-obs          Add observations to entity
  entity-open             Open entities
  entity-search           Search entities
  relation-create         Create relation
  task-create             Create task
  task-query              Query tasks
  task-update             Update task
  model-init              Initialize neural model
  model-train             Train model
  model-predict           Predict with model
  model-status            Model status
  model-save              Save model
  model-load              Load model
  embed-text              Generate embedding for text
  embed-batch             Generate embeddings for batch of texts
  remember                Remember a fact and create its semantic embedding
  sweep-expired           Purge expired facts and their vectors immediately
  recall                  Recall facts by semantic query without supplying raw vectors
  vector-upsert-fact      Upsert fact embedding for vector search
  vector-search-facts     Search facts by vector similarity
  sync-push               Push local changes to peers
  sync-pull               Pull changes from peers
  sync-status             Sync status
  plugin-search           Search plugin registry
  plugin-install          Install plugin
  plugin-uninstall        Uninstall plugin
  plugin-call             Call plugin tool
  plugin-registry-stats   Plugin registry stats
  plugin-update-registry  Update plugin registry
  think                   Sequential thinking
  thought-history         Thought history
  thought-reset           Reset thoughts
  conclusion              Add conclusion
  feedback                Feedback
  explain-rank            Explain rank
  health                  Health check
  db-backup               Create a consistent SQLite backup
  db-restore              Restore the database from a verified SQLite backup
  audit                   Verify or export the tamper-evident audit chain
  sql                     Run raw SQL query
  model                   Download a Model2Vec model for later offline use
  context                 AI Continuity and context lifecycle commands
  help                    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          State directory (default: $HOME/.koala)
          
          [env: KOALA_STATE_DIR=]

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - text: Human-readable text output
          - json: JSON output for scripting
          
          [default: text]

      --serve
          Run as MCP server over stdio (full 53 tools)

      --offline
          Disable all runtime network access; requires a local model directory

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

Usage: koala-rust plugin-install [OPTIONS] --name <NAME>

Options:
      --name <NAME>
          Plugin name

      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          State directory (default: $HOME/.koala)
          
          [env: KOALA_STATE_DIR=]

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - text: Human-readable text output
          - json: JSON output for scripting
          
          [default: text]

      --version <VERSION>
          Version (optional)

      --offline
          Disable all runtime network access; requires a local model directory

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

recall:
Recall facts by semantic query without supplying raw vectors

Usage: koala-rust recall [OPTIONS] --query <QUERY>

Options:
      --query <QUERY>
          Natural-language search query

      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          State directory (default: $HOME/.koala)
          
          [env: KOALA_STATE_DIR=]

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - text: Human-readable text output
          - json: JSON output for scripting
          
          [default: text]

      --k <K>
          Number of results
          
          [default: 5]

      --keyword-weight <KEYWORD_WEIGHT>
          Keyword overlap weight
          
          [default: 0.35]

      --as-of <AS_OF>
          Restrict recall to the newest fact versions known at this timestamp

      --offline
          Disable all runtime network access; requires a local model directory

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
